name: Model Bloat Audit
description: Read-only model clean-up report: unused families and types, in-place families, families with very many types, imported CAD files, and an overall cleanliness estimate. Never deletes or purges anything.
author: AEC Model Bridge

snapshot_id.description: ID of a saved semantic snapshot (returned by snapshot_take or revit_extract_snapshot). Leave empty to audit the built-in sample model.

large_type_threshold.description: A family with more types than this is reported as having very many types. Default 25.

max_items.description: Maximum number of items listed per section (the counts always cover everything). Default 50.
